title: Befana's Broomstick Bunion Brew
tagline: A bubbling Italian-legend cauldron of fluff, fluff and more fluff.

ingredients.item: soggy leaf mulch from the gutter
pond-green slime made of lost buttons and wishes
fluffy dust bunnies from under the sofa

steps:
Heave the cauldron on, give it a clang,
Then stir with the broom till the bristles go bang!

Plop in the socks, all three, one by one,
They're ripe as a gorilla's armpit in the sun!

Tear up the trainer tongues, squelchy and grey,
Then shower in leaf mulch to hide them away!

Squeeze the dead pens till they gurgle and ooze,
Then blob in the button slime, wobbling in blues!

Toss in the dust bunnies, let them all hop,
Sprinkle the moonlight and stir till you pop!
rhyme:
Bubble and bumble, my cauldron's a-grumble,
In goes a broom head, all bristly and humble!
Three smelly socks, left feet, ripe and rank,
Plop! Down they go with a gloopy old clank!
Trainer tongues, soggy, all tangy and green,
Slap in the slimiest slurp ever seen!
Dust bunnies bounce in, a fluffy grey crowd,
Stir with a cackle, a-ha-ha, out loud!
A sprinkle of moonlight, a button-slime dollop,
Brew up the bunion brew, glorp, glop and wallop!
image_prompt: A huge dented black cauldron overflowing with lumpy grey-green sludge, a bristly broom head poking out, striped odd socks draped over the rim, soggy leaves, dust bunnies floating on top, and bright dried felt-tip pens stuck upright like candles in the goo.
alt_text: A dented cauldron brimming with grey-green sludge, a broom head, draped socks, leaves, dust bunnies and felt-tip pens sticking out.
caption_hook:
Italy week, and the old Befana legend got a very messy makeover. Somebody's left socks have clearly been busy.

Would you stir it, or run for the hills?
